intro.en: Equipment wire carries power, control, safety and sensor circuits inside machines and industrial control panels. Its suitability depends on where the conductor is installed, how it is protected and which standard governs the completed equipment.
intro.zh: 设备用电线在机器与工业控制柜内部承担动力、控制、安全和传感回路。是否适用取决于导体安装位置、保护方式以及完整设备所遵循的标准。

knowledge.en: UL 1063 machine-tool wire, UL 758 appliance wiring material and field-installed wiring are different product and installation scopes. IEC 60204-1 begins at the connection of the supply to a machine's electrical equipment; the project must therefore map every circuit across panel, machine and moving boundaries.
knowledge.zh: UL 1063 机床电线、UL 758 器具布线材料与现场敷设电线属于不同产品和安装范围。IEC 60204-1 的范围从机器电气设备的电源连接点开始，因此项目必须绘制每条回路跨越控制柜、机身与运动边界的路径。

subtitle.en: Specify the electrical path from panel entry to machine endpoint
subtitle.zh: 从控制柜入口到机器端点定义完整电气路径

lead.en: Coordinate MTW, AWM, hook-up wire, conductor, insulation, routing, terminals and machine-level evidence instead of selecting by colour or gauge alone.
lead.zh: 协同审核 MTW、AWM、电子线、导体、绝缘、布线、端接与整机证据，而不是只按颜色或线径选线。

title.en: Start with the machine boundary, not the wire catalogue
title.zh: 先确定机器边界，再查线材目录

copy.en: Equipment wire can sit inside an industrial control panel, pass through a machine frame or terminate at a motor, valve, sensor or operator station. Those positions do not automatically share one installation rule. Document the supply connection, panel boundary, fixed raceway, exposed segment and service disconnect before choosing a product designation.
copy.zh: 设备用电线可能位于工业控制柜内部，也可能穿过机架并终止于电机、阀门、传感器或操作站。这些位置不会自动共享同一安装规则。选定产品型号前，应先记录电源连接点、控制柜边界、固定线槽、暴露段和维修断开点。

title.en: MTW and AWM identify different approval paths
title.zh: MTW 与 AWM 对应不同批准路径

copy.en: Machine Tool Wire is covered by UL 1063. Appliance Wiring Material is covered by UL 758 and is identified by a specific style and conditions of acceptability. Familiar labels such as UL 1015 or UL 1007 must be checked as exact AWM styles, not treated as universal synonyms for every machine wire. Marking, manufacturer file and intended use matter when approving an equivalent.
copy.zh: 机床电线由 UL 1063 覆盖；器具布线材料由 UL 758 覆盖，并通过具体 Style 与使用条件识别。UL 1015、UL 1007 等熟悉名称必须作为准确 AWM Style 审核，不能视为所有设备线的通用同义词。批准替代料时，印字、制造商档案和预期用途都需要确认。

title.en: Size the conductor from the complete circuit
title.zh: 从完整回路确定导体规格

copy.en: Current, duty cycle, route length, voltage-drop target, ambient temperature, grouping and terminal resistance all affect conductor selection. IEC 60228 defines conductor classes and resistance requirements for applicable finished cables, but the cable product standard still determines applicability. Fine stranding may improve handling; it does not independently establish ampacity or dynamic life.
copy.zh: 电流、占空比、路径长度、压降目标、环境温度、成束状态和端子电阻都会影响导体选择。IEC 60228 为适用成品电缆规定导体类别与电阻要求，但是否适用仍由具体线缆产品标准决定。细绞结构可能改善装配手感，却不能单独证明载流能力或动态寿命。

title.en: Insulation is a system of ratings and exposures
title.zh: 绝缘是一组额定值与环境条件

copy.en: PVC, cross-linked polyolefin, nylon-covered constructions and other compounds can differ in temperature, voltage, oil, chemical, abrasion and flame performance. A higher temperature number does not automatically make a wire suitable. Review the exact construction, print legend, minimum wall, outside diameter and compatibility with terminals, seals and wire duct.
copy.zh: PVC、交联聚烯烃、尼龙护层及其他材料在温度、电压、耐油、耐化学、耐磨与阻燃性能上各不相同。更高的温度数字并不自动代表更适用，应审核准确结构、印字、最小壁厚、外径以及与端子、密封件和线槽的兼容性。

title.en: Fixed routing still needs mechanical control
title.zh: 固定布线同样需要机械控制

copy.en: Inside a panel or machine, wire duct fill, bend location, clamp spacing, sharp edges, heat sources and separation between power and sensitive signal circuits influence reliability and service access. Routing should preserve terminal visibility and allow a component to be replaced without pulling adjacent circuits or hiding identification.
copy.zh: 在控制柜或机器内部，线槽填充、弯折位置、夹持间距、锐边、热源以及动力回路与敏感信号回路之间的分隔，都会影响可靠性和维修可达性。布线应保留端子可见性，并允许更换元件时不拉扯相邻回路或遮挡标识。

title.zh: 出现运动后，线材问题随之改变

copy.en: A cabinet door, moving head, robot axis or sliding module introduces bend, torsion, acceleration and repeated cycle requirements. The moving length, neutral axis, minimum radius, support points and cycle profile must be defined. A wire that is flexible during installation is not automatically a continuous-flex or drag-chain cable.
copy.zh: 柜门、移动头、机器人轴或滑动模块会引入弯折、扭转、加速度和重复循环要求。必须定义运动长度、中性轴、最小半径、支撑点与循环谱。安装时手感柔软的电线，并不自动属于连续弯曲线或拖链电缆。

title.en: Terminal, tool and wire must be released together
title.zh: 端子、工具与线材必须共同放行

copy.en: Ferrules, open-barrel contacts, ring and fork terminals, quick-connects and board connectors each impose conductor, insulation and strip requirements. The approved combination includes contact part number, wire range, applicator or tool, crimp geometry, pull criteria, insertion and terminal retention. Visual appearance alone cannot approve a crimp.
copy.zh: 管形端头、开口式端子、环形与叉形端子、快接插片和板端连接器分别限定导体、绝缘和剥线要求。获批组合应包括端子料号、线材范围、模具或工具、压接几何、拉力判定、插入与端子保持。仅凭外观不能批准压接。

title.en: Release evidence belongs to the finished machine circuit
title.zh: 放行证据应对应成品机器回路

copy.en: Incoming identity and marking control the material. Cut, strip, crimp, label and routing checks control the process. The finished harness may then require continuity, insulation resistance, dielectric strength, protective-bonding continuity, pull, temperature-rise or functional checks defined by the project. A recognized wire component does not certify the complete machine.
copy.zh: 来料身份与印字控制物料，裁线、剥线、压接、标签和布线检查控制工艺。随后，成品线束还可能需要项目规定的导通、绝缘电阻、耐压、保护联结连续性、拉力、温升或功能检查。获得认可的线材元件并不等于完整机器已经认证。

inputs.en: Destination market, machine type and governing equipment standard
inputs.zh: 目标市场、机器类型与适用设备标准

inputs.en: Circuit list with voltage, current, duty, length and protection
inputs.zh: 包含电压、电流、占空比、长度与保护的回路表

inputs.en: Panel, machine, exposed and moving route map
inputs.zh: 控制柜、机身、暴露段与运动段路径图

inputs.en: Exact MTW, AWM style or other wire designation and marking
inputs.zh: 准确 MTW、AWM Style 或其他线材型号与印字

inputs.en: Terminal, connector, wire duct, gland and protection references
inputs.zh: 端子、连接器、线槽、格兰与防护资料

inputs.en: Drawing, sample, quantity, change control and validation limits
inputs.zh: 图纸、样品、数量、变更控制与验证限值

q.en: Is equipment wire the same as building wire?
q.zh: 设备用电线等同于建筑布线吗？

a.en: No. Product marking, installation location and governing code determine where a wire may be used.
a.zh: 不等同。线材印字、安装位置与适用法规共同决定允许用途。

q.en: Can UL 1015 replace any MTW wire?
q.zh: UL 1015 可以替代任意 MTW 电线吗？

a.en: Not by name alone. Compare exact approvals, ratings, construction, use conditions, terminal compatibility and project requirements.
a.zh: 不能仅凭名称替代。必须比较准确认可、额定值、结构、使用条件、端子兼容性与项目要求。

q.en: Does a stranded conductor mean continuous-flex use?
q.zh: 绞合导体就代表可以连续弯曲吗？

a.en: No. Continuous movement requires a cable construction, routing method and cycle validation intended for that motion.
a.zh: 不代表。连续运动需要针对该运动设计的线缆结构、布线方法与循环验证。

q.en: What should be checked after a wire-source change?
q.zh: 更换线材来源后需要检查什么？

a.en: Review marking, approval file, conductor resistance and stranding, insulation dimensions and properties, terminal fit, process settings and affected validation.
a.zh: 应审核印字、认可档案、导体电阻与绞合、绝缘尺寸与性能、端子匹配、工艺参数及受影响验证。
